eas_text: A civil authority has issued A LAW ENFORCEMENT WARNING for the following counties or areas: Montgomery, OH; at 6:21 AM on AUG 11, 2025 Effective until 7:21 AM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
Vehicle pursuit terminated in the area of Oak Creek South park in Washington Twp.  Large police presence in the area.  Shelter in place the suspect could be armed.  Male last seen wearing black pants and blue long sleeve shirt
Do not approach.  Call 911 if seen.
